text:
Amazon Bedrock: new retention text on the data handling page as of Nov 24.
Before: "...Chat Completions, and Responses APIs."
After: "...Chat Completions, and Responses APIs, and the InvokeModel and Converse APIs on the bedrock-runtime endpoint."
https://inference-index.vercel.app/changelog

entry.before: the setting is enforced consistently across the Messages, Chat Completions, and Responses APIs.
entry.after: the setting is enforced consistently across the Messages, Chat Completions, and Responses APIs, and the InvokeModel and Converse APIs on the bedrock-runtime endpoint.
